name: @dina/net-policy
description: Dina's outbound network policy, pure and runtime-neutral: the special-use address classifier (every range in the IANA IPv4 and IPv6 special-purpose registries, with the IPv4 inside mapped, 6to4 and NAT64 forms checked), and the policy HTTP request/result contract that the Node socket and the phone's native transport implement (docs/UCP_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md §3.3, §3.4).
